hooks.name: Dependency doc reminder

action.command: echo 'package.json or pnpm-lock.yaml changed: update docs/dependencies.md with a row (name, exact version, license, reason) for any new dependency, and verify every added package is pinned to an exact version (no ^ or ~).'

hooks.description: When a package.json or pnpm-lock.yaml is saved, reminds to update docs/dependencies.md and to verify exact version pins. Report only, edits nothing.
